summary: Closure review: previous required revision (preregistered topology‑cluster breakdown H3) has not been addressed. Manuscript remains well documented and reproducible, but it must explicitly disclose whether H3 was executed or point to archived per‑cluster artifacts; wording that implies a completed per‑cluster confirmatory comparison should be corrected or qualified.
critical_issues: The preregistered topology‑cluster confirmatory hypothesis (H3) is asserted in the manuscript text (e.g., wording that the study compares pipelines “across two simulated topologies”) but the archived analysis artifacts and confirmatory results contain only the pooled paired analysis. The manuscript does not include the required explicit disclosure that H3 was not executed/archived or, alternatively, does not point to archived per‑cluster results. This mismatch between preregistration and reported results is a critical unresolved issue for this closure review.
required_revisions: Add an explicit, prominent disclosure in Methods and/or Results stating whether the preregistered topology‑cluster breakdown (H3) was executed and archived. If H3 was not executed, state that clearly and explain (pointing to archived artifacts that show only the pooled analysis). If per‑cluster analyses are already archived, identify the exact archived artifact paths/filenames and include a brief per‑cluster summary (counts and contingency table) in the manuscript. Also remove or qualify any manuscript phrasing that currently implies a completed per‑cluster confirmatory inference if it was not done.
optional_revisions: Briefly (one short paragraph) clarify why the shared_initial_candidate paired design was chosen and how that design choice likely reduced repair invocation and affects external validity.

Add a concise pointer (artifact paths and filenames) in the Methods or Disclosure Statement to the key archived analysis artifacts used for the primary result (e.g., analysis/paired_contingency_table.csv, analysis/condition_summary.csv, analysis/results.json, execution/execution_manifest.json) to assist reproducibility; do not add new analysis outputs.
